intro.zh: 清华大学未央书院毕业，数理基础科学与能源动力工程背景。研究与开发围绕能源系统建模、科学计算，以及连接模型、数据和使用者的软件。
intro.en: Tsinghua University graduate with a background in mathematics, physics, and energy engineering. My work spans physical modelling, scientific computing, and software that connects models, data, and people.

description.zh: 段培耀 / Peiyao Duan。清华大学毕业，关注能源系统、物理建模、科学计算与软件开发。查看研究项目、开源作品与中英文简历。
description.en: Peiyao Duan — Tsinghua University graduate. Energy systems, physical modelling, scientific computing, and software development. Research projects, open-source work, and résumé.

zh.program: 数理基础科学 + 能源与动力工程
zh.note: 本科毕业。以数理方法理解问题，以工程实践检验想法。

en.note: Undergraduate education, completed. A foundation in mathematics, physics, and engineering practice.

zh.title: 水木汇 · 校园生活服务平台
zh.text: 参与清点评、班团面板与个人主页开发，引入标准组件库，编写前端设计与开发指南。

en.title: Shuimuhui · Campus services
en.text: Developed campus review, class-group, and profile modules; introduced a component library and wrote front-end guidelines.

zh.title: 声学超材料结构设计
zh.text: 设计兼顾吸声与流通的圆环柱状结构，使用 COMSOL 仿真，并通过实验台测量检验。

en.title: Acoustic metamaterial design
en.text: Designed an annular structure balancing sound absorption and airflow, with COMSOL simulation and bench measurements.

about.zh: 我的学习和实践横跨数理、能源与软件。研究中，我关注物理模型的边界、数据的来源和实验是否可以复现；开发中，我关心系统能否被理解、维护，并真正用于解决问题。
about.en: My studies and projects connect mathematics, energy, and software. In research, I care about model boundaries, data provenance, and reproducibility. In development, I focus on systems that people can understand, maintain, and use.

photography.zh: 工作之外喜欢摄影，是视觉中国签约摄影师。
photography.en: Outside my technical work, I enjoy photography and am a contracted contributor to Visual China Group.
